stalls.zh: 金村香噴三角骨／爆炸大魷魚
stalls.summaryZh: 三角骨帶中藥與胡椒香，大魷魚整隻炸好再剪開，建議五點左右到以免久排。
stalls.summaryEn: Herb-and-pepper fried chicken shoulder pieces and whole fried squid cut to order; arrive around 5 pm to dodge the line.

stalls.summaryZh: 邊緣煎得酥脆，蚵仔顆粒飽滿。

sources.title: 新永華夜市：搬新家美味升級全攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 辣湯底夠味，爆漿起司丸和凍豆腐是常點品項。
stalls.summaryEn: Spicy broth; the molten cheese balls and frozen tofu are the usual picks.

sources.title: 新永華夜市：搬新家美味升級全攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 炭香明顯、雞排多汁，但尖峰時段可能要等半小時以上。
stalls.summaryEn: Strong charcoal flavour and juicy chicken cutlet, though peak waits can top 30 minutes.
